[ICCV 2025] GraspCoT: Integrating Physical Property Reasoning for 6-DoF Grasping under Flexible Language Instructions

GraspCoT: Integrating Physical Property Reasoning for 6-DoF Grasping under Flexible Language Instructions (ICCV 2025) Xiaomeng Chu, Jiajun Deng, Guoliang You, Wei Liu, Xingchen Li, Jianmin Ji, Yanyong Zhang ## Overview This repository is an official implementation of [GraspCOT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.16013), an innovative 6-DoF grasp detection framework that integrates a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning mechanism oriented to physical properties, guided by auxiliary question-answering (QA) tasks. The video demonstration is included [here](assets/2338_video_demo.mp4). ## Environment We test our codes under the following environment: * Python 3.10 * Pytorch 2.1.0 * CUDA Version 11.8 1. Clone this repository. 2. Install packages. 3. Install other dependencies: ## Prepare Dataset 1. Make data folder. 2. Download nuScenes from [Grasp-Anything-6D](https://huggingface.co/datasets/airvlab/Grasp-Anything-6D), follow their usage instructions, and put it in `data/grasp_anything`. 3. Download the revised scenario description file with bugs fixed from [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hpDD6PSA9l4vqDmtyUfM9rqzHpK9aQs-/view?usp=sharing), unzip, and replace the original directory `scene_description` (downloaded from the previous step) in `data/grasp_anything`. 4. Download the generated flexible instruction info files of [train](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VLga3xvwh5qyUNNyb73odzxDvSttCMiA/view?usp=sharing) and [val](https://drive.google.com/file/d/17Ri0tnFqir023IIvWpT-AeC1RuqvBR68/view?usp=sharing) sets, and put them in `data/grasp_anything/dialogues`. 5. Generate the projected images, depth maps, and a series of grasping info files from the colored point cloud. 6. Folder structure: ## Training 1. Make a folder for pretrained LLM models. 2. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：GraspCoT 在 LLaVA-3D-7B 视觉语言模型与 CLIP 视觉编码器基础上，引入面向物理属性的思维链（CoT）推理，并用一组辅助问答（QA）任务作为中间监督，端到端地根据灵活语言指令预测 6-DoF 抓取位姿，数据构建于 Grasp-Anything-6D（nuScenes 衍生）之上并配以新生成的柔性指令对话数据。


# 一、动机

> 现有 6-DoF 抓取检测大多直接从视觉/点云回归抓取位姿，缺乏对物体物理属性（材质、重量、易碎性等）的显式推理，且语言条件往往是固定模板，难以适配灵活多变的自然语言指令。


# 二、方法

> GraspCoT 在 LLaVA-3D-7B 视觉语言模型与 CLIP 视觉编码器基础上，引入面向物理属性的思维链（CoT）推理，并用一组辅助问答（QA）任务作为中间监督，端到端地根据灵活语言指令预测 6-DoF 抓取位姿，数据构建于 Grasp-Anything-6D（nuScenes 衍生）之上并配以新生成的柔性指令对话数据。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文被 ICCV 2025 接收，并开源了完整代码、修订后的场景描述文件以及 train/val 柔性指令对话数据；作者提供了视频演示。但所给摘要/仓库说明中未给出成功率、AP 等具体数值指标，需查阅原文实验表格确认。


# 四、对我的启发

> 把 LLM 的显式物理属性推理引入抓取位姿估计是合理且有前景的方向，但性能上限强依赖 Grasp-Anything-6D 这类大规模抓取-语言配对数据，且 CoT 与 QA 辅助任务的推理开销对真实机器人在线闭环抓取的实时性影响未在摘要中讨论。与机器人操作/具身智能课题直接相关。
